title: Open-source model-file scanner coverage vs. attack-vector taxonomy
author: Made with AI by MV2 of Munim, Inc.
license: CC BY 4.0 (this data); code in this repository is Apache-2.0
methodology: Documentation- and source-based coverage review, NOT an executed benchmark. Each cell reflects what a tool's own documentation, source, or linked advisory states it detects as of the generated date; the scanners were NOT run against a shared corpus here. Statuses: 'detects' = the tool documents detection of this vector; 'partial' = documents related/incomplete handling, or is historically affected; 'no' = in the tool's scope but not documented as covered; 'out-of-scope' = the tool does not target this format/layer at all; 'unknown' = not determinable from public docs. For executed head-to-head results see Promptfoo's ModelAudit-vs-ModelScan run and the cited academic evasion papers. ModelAudit cells were re-checked against its scanner reference (promptfoo.dev/docs/model-audit/scanners/) on 2026-10-16.

status_legend.partial: related or incomplete handling, or historically affected
status_legend.no: within the tool's scope but not documented as covered
status_legend.out-of-scope: tool does not target this format/layer

catches 2 of the 3 published ShadowPickle variants: its allowlist flags the PyPI-Injected (raft.run) and External-Modules (external.dangerous_func) imports as PKL003 (unrecognised reconstructor), which blacklist scanners miss; misses the Overwritten (collections.OrderedDict) variant by design, as its opcode stream is byte-identical to a legitimate OrderedDict reduce - a fundamental static limit mitigated by dependency integrity, not an opcode rule. Source-derived and confirmed in a sealed no-network sandbox (2026-10-22).

ModelAudit ships a dedicated Flax/JAX scanner for .msgpack/.flax/.orbax/.jax that 'analyzes Flax/JAX model files serialized in MessagePack format and other JAX-specific formats', flagging suspicious MessagePack structures that could exploit deserializers and embedded code objects / executable content

no Flax/MessagePack detector in keras-model-scan; a documented coverage gap. The weights-only .msgpack container carries no file-at-rest code-execution signal a static scanner would flag - the object-reconstruction risk (custom ext_hook) is a runtime checkpointer path - so this is a roadmap note, not a shipped rule
